primary_bio_chi_event.outcome: early drug-tolerant persistence, followed by later resistant states
primary_bio_chi_event.substrate_intervention: H3K27me3 depletion with UNC1999/EZH2i-1 before or with 5-FU
primary_bio_chi_event.frozen_question: Does changing the pre-treatment chromatin substrate alter which lineages can occupy the persister state, and is any such fate change captured by baseline transcriptomic modal organization?

inheritance_carrier.future_persister_rule: a chemonaive lineage is future-persister if the same barcode occurs in any frozen early-persister sample
inheritance_carrier.nonpersisting_rule: a barcoded chemonaive lineage absent from all frozen early-persister samples
inheritance_carrier.cell_level_pseudoreplication_control: aggregate baseline PCA coordinates to one centroid per lineage barcode before group testing

baseline_modal_test.basis_status: source-native unsupervised PCA fit by the published pipeline across the source analysis cells; outcome data contributed to the unsupervised basis, so this is P0-Q representation qualification rather than prospective prediction
baseline_modal_test.retention: minimum leading PCs whose sample-score variances reach at least 80% cumulative variance
baseline_modal_test.standardization: z-scale retained PC coordinates across baseline lineage centroids using population SD; remove zero-variance PCs
baseline_modal_test.primary_statistic: Euclidean distance between future-persister and nonpersisting lineage centroids in standardized retained-PC space
baseline_modal_test.permutation: 10000 lineage-label permutations preserving observed group sizes; fixed seed 20260924; one-sided statistic >= observed
baseline_modal_test.secondary: leave-one-lineage-out nearest-centroid balanced accuracy in the same standardized retained-PC space; compare against the same frozen label permutations
baseline_modal_test.interpretation: tests whether baseline transcriptomic modal organization carries detectable inheritance information; failure does not negate the whole-event lineage/substrate phenomenon

substrate_intervention_lineage_test.primary_metric: unique lineage barcodes divided by number of barcoded cells within each sample
substrate_intervention_lineage_test.secondary_metric: normalized Shannon entropy of lineage counts, defined as Shannon/log(number of unique barcodes) when more than one lineage is present
substrate_intervention_lineage_test.directional_gate: both matched timepoints must show higher primary lineage diversity under UNC+5FU than 5FU alone
substrate_intervention_lineage_test.no_p_value: two matched timepoints are treated as deterministic source lanes, not as an inferential sample

cluster_specific_sensitivity.state_definition: among all cells in the four matched samples, choose the frozen louvain_partition with the highest median CDH2 expression before reading barcode diversity by treatment
cluster_specific_sensitivity.metric: same unique-lineage fraction and normalized Shannon entropy
cluster_specific_sensitivity.role: source-native sensitivity matching the paper's CDH2-high persister interpretation; not required for the primary whole-event gate
cluster_specific_sensitivity.tie_rule: if multiple louvain partitions have exactly equal highest median CDH2, choose lexicographically smallest partition label

substrate_intervention_lineage_test.secondary_metric_zero_case: normalized Shannon entropy is 0 for one unique lineage and n/a if no barcoded cells

intervention_modal_relation.purpose: determine whether substrate-induced lineage broadening is accompanied by a large transcriptomic modal shift or can occur with comparatively preserved modal state
intervention_modal_relation.retention: minimum leading PCs reaching at least 80% cumulative score variance
intervention_modal_relation.metric: Euclidean distance between matched 5FU and UNC+5FU sample centroids after z-scaling retained PCs across all source-object cells
intervention_modal_relation.comparator: distance between the two chemonaive source samples if both are present in the same PCA object; otherwise report without promotion comparator

source_reported_external_replication.fact_role: paper-level contextual replication only unless exact machine-readable functional values are independently frozen and recomputed

scalar_gate.reason: No source-native continuous-time generator has been established for this lineage-level persistence event. Scalar construction is not required to test substrate-conditioned fate.

promotion_logic.Bio_Chi_relation_supported_if: the frozen matched UNC+5FU lineage-diversity gate passes and carrier mapping is valid
promotion_logic.modal_inheritance_supported_if: baseline lineage-level PCA primary permutation p <= 0.05 under the frozen test
promotion_logic.modal_not_required_if: the Bio Chi lineage gate passes but baseline modal inheritance test does not
promotion_logic.Bio_Chi_relation_refused_if: matched lineage-diversity gate fails or required barcode/sample mapping is invalid
